svg.title: Sequential quantum decisions and their possible futures
svg.desc: Above, one quantum system is reused through three changing task contexts. Each context offers a finite set of two discrete control operations, represented by separate buttons; the filled button is selected and its colored connector leads to a matching gate on the quantum-system path, explicitly showing the operation applied between the input and output states. Below, a simplified planning tree alternates action choices, drawn as diamonds and solid connections, with random outcomes, drawn as circles and dashed connections. A blue outcome-dependent plan begins with a smaller immediate reward but reaches larger cumulative rewards. Gold bars consistently represent reward. Values are conceptual illustrations, not model results.
